identityBrief: repo://waterfall.sh/DESIGN.md, repo://waterfall.sh/PERFECT.md, repo://waterfall.sh/OFFER.md, and the waterfall.sh entry in preferences/owner-preferences.json. No separate identity-brief file exists yet.
intent: Keep waterfall.sh's dark deep-water identity and blue W, and bring it to the accepted shapeable.art level of polish: one type scale, airy rhythm, restraint, and one clear path to the $30 founding license.
northStar: A developer understands in one pass that waterfall.sh is a local board that routes routine prompts to the cheapest capable model and keeps hard work for Claude or Grok, sees the real board, and either buys the $30 license or downloads it.

personality.signature: A deep-water board (#0b1220) with chalk text and a single waterfall blue (#5ec6ff); the blue W tile; mono uppercase eyebrows; large tight sans headlines; one illustrative still of the real local board.
mustPreserve: The dark deep-water palette and the blue W mark (brand/logo.svg, brand/favicon.svg).
Lowercase waterfall wordmark with the .sh in waterfall blue.
System sans for interface and system mono for labels and commands; no web fonts.
Waterfall blue as the single signal color; good green only for savings and success.
Honest status about what works today, what is being wired up, and what is pending.
The tagline: Flip projects. Pay the least for the job.
mustNotBecome: Shapeable's light paper look; Adam chose Same quality, keep dark.
A generic SaaS gradient landing page.
A wall of text or a long promotional explainer.
A page that shows fabricated savings, users, or model results as real.
A logo wall of third-party AI products used as decoration.

color.strategy: Dark only. Deep-water surfaces carry everything; waterfall blue is scarce and means action, focus, links, or the mark. Good green is reserved for savings and success figures. Secondary text never drops below the AA floor of #7f8c99. The light column records that no light theme exists rather than inventing one.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Body background on every route, with at most one soft radial wash.

tokens.name: board2
tokens.usage: Cards, the price panel, and the product frame.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table bodies, the board sidebar in the still.

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: Ledes, card copy, and inactive navigation.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Meta, captions, and labels. AA floor: never use the retired #5c6873.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, focus rings, eyebrows, and the W.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Selected or highlighted rows and chips.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Savings figures and success states only.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Real warnings only, always with text.

typography.strategy: One scale replaces the 13 measured sizes and 5 weights. Sans carries headlines and reading; mono is semantic for eyebrows, labels, commands, and numbers. Weights are 400, 600, and 700 only. Nothing essential renders below 12px.

families.fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, Helvetica, sans-serif
ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.usage: Eyebrows, meta, code blocks, and figures.

scale.name: lede
scale.usage: The one-sentence intro under a headline.

scale.name: label
scale.usage: Eyebrows and meta. 12px is the floor.

spacing.density: Airy. Sections are separated by 120px on desktop and 72px on mobile; one idea per section. Density is allowed only inside data tables and the product still.

shape.border: One-pixel line-colored borders where containment explains structure.
shape.elevation: Flat surfaces. Only the product frame carries a deep shadow so it reads as a window on the board.
shape.signatureShape: Rounded 10px controls, 14px cards, and a 16px product frame around the illustrative board.

layout.strategy: Home has at most five sections: hero (headline, one sentence, Buy $30 and Download, trust line, then the product still), how it falls, workshop and leaderboard, honest status, and install. Every page shares one nav: cascade, leaderboard, workshop, docs (about), and a compact Buy $30. Each section intro is at most two short sentences.

motion.principle: Motion confirms state (hover, focus, a still easing into view) and never decorates.
motion.reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, transitions, animations, and smooth scrolling are off and every state renders complete and static.

focus.rule: Every interactive element shows a visible focus-visible ring, and a skip link reaches the main content first.

imagery.direction: Show the real product: one stageshow-style still of the local board built from its real UI (sidebar Dashboard, Cascade, Agents, Pace; card Classify and route; metrics Prompts routed, Tokens avoided, Est. saved), captioned Illustrative board. Example numbers.
allowed: Code-built product stills of the real board, aria-hidden with data-shapeable-illustration and a visible caption of at least 12px.
Real command lines and real feature names.
forbidden: Third-party product logos used as decoration.
Fabricated savings, usage, or users presented as real.

patterns.name: unified-nav
patterns.intent: Make every page read as one product.
rules: Brand left; cascade, leaderboard, workshop, docs, then a compact Buy $30 on the right.
Every link has a 44px hit area; non-essential links collapse on narrow screens while Buy $30 stays.
The current page is marked with aria-current.

patterns.name: hero-buy-path
patterns.intent: One clear path to the founding license.
rules: The $30 price and the primary Buy action appear once, in the hero.
Download for Windows is the secondary action.
A mono trust line states one-time, your own keys, no token markup, and the unsigned installer.

patterns.name: board-still
patterns.intent: Show the real local board without exposing private data.
rules: Build the still from the board's real structure and labels.
Wrap it in aria-hidden plus data-shapeable-illustration with a visible caption.
Use example numbers and say so in the caption.

patterns.name: honest-status
patterns.intent: Keep trust by separating shipped behavior from unfinished work.
rules: Three columns: works today, being wired up, pending code or evidence.
The pending column is labelled a roadmap, not a guarantee.

content.voice: A terse developer explaining a tool to another developer: plain, specific, frugal, and honest about limits.
rules: Lead with what it does in one sentence.
Every number has a source or is labelled an example.
State limits (unsigned installer, Windows-only desktop package) next to the download.
Keep each section intro to two short sentences at most.
bannedPatterns: Hype words such as revolutionary, magic, or 10x.

responsiveRules.name: mobile-sequence
responsiveRules.rule: At 390px the headline, one sentence, Buy and Download, trust line, then the product still read in that order with no horizontal page overflow.
responsiveRules.acceptance: Site audit reports zero horizontal overflow and zero offscreen page text at 390 x 844.

responsiveRules.name: touch-and-type-floors
responsiveRules.rule: No text below 12px and every non-inline control at least 44 by 44px at every width.
responsiveRules.acceptance: Site audit reports zero tiny page text and zero comfortable touch-target shortfalls.

accessibility.name: contrast
accessibility.rule: All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA on deep-water surfaces; secondary text uses dust or faint, never the retired #5c6873.
accessibility.acceptance: axe-core reports zero color-contrast violations at both viewports.

accessibility.name: semantics-and-focus
accessibility.rule: Every page has a title, lang, one h1, a skip link, labelled controls, and a visible 3px accent focus ring.
accessibility.acceptance: axe-core reports zero critical or serious violations; manual keyboard pass reaches every control.

accessibility.name: reduced-motion
accessibility.rule: No transition or animation remains active under prefers-reduced-motion.
accessibility.acceptance: Site audit reports zero motion-active-under-reduce elements.

influences.title: Linear
influences.author: Linear
influences.principle: Quiet chrome and a strong type hierarchy, with the accent used sparingly.
influences.take: A calm nav and restrained use of waterfall blue.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy Linear's assets, layouts, gradients, or trade dress.

influences.title: Raycast
influences.author: Raycast
influences.principle: Minimal ornament and fast, obvious actions.
influences.take: Primary actions are short and immediate; no decorative motion.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not copy Raycast's assets, layouts, or visual identity.

influences.title: stageshow product-still technique
influences.author: benjitaylor/skills (MIT)
influences.principle: Show the product as a composed still built from real UI primitives, with real words only where they carry meaning.
influences.take: The illustrative still of the local board in the hero.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not reuse the kit's example scenes, names, or compositions.

influences.title: benji-taylor-design-eval skill
influences.author: Denis Darkin (community skill inferred from Benji Taylor's public work; MIT)
influences.principle: Progressive disclosure, motion as meaning, the simplicity, fluidity, and delight triad, craft in edge states, trust through clarity.
influences.take: One clear buy path and progressive disclosure: details live on workshop, leaderboard, and docs pages, not the home page.
influences.doNotCopy: Do not adopt any product's visual language or imply endorsement by Benji Taylor.

governance.sourceOfTruth: This design-system.json plus repo://waterfall.sh/DESIGN.md; the Claude guide is rendered from this file deterministically. Runtime tokens live in waterfall.sh/site.css :root and must match.
governance.versioning: Semantic versioning. Patch clarifies evidence, minor adds compatible rules or tokens, major changes identity.
governance.adoption: Draft. Redesign previews A, B, and C were rejected on 2026-11-04 because they did not come out of the Shapeable workflow; this pack is the first workflow step. The owner must accept the exact reviewed preview before this becomes owner-approved.
governance.deviations: Record each deviation with rationale, affected page, owner, and expiry in the next pack version.
governance.reviewCadence: Re-audit the full site after any material visual, interaction, or route change; persist every owner direction or rejection to the ledger before the next revision.

readFirst: Read repo://waterfall.sh/DESIGN.md, PERFECT.md, and this design system before any visual change.
Read the waterfall.sh entry in shapeable.art preferences/owner-preferences.json, including its feedback.
decisionRules: Keep the dark deep-water identity; never adopt Shapeable's light look for this site.
Use only the type scale 12, 14, 16, 20, 28, 40, 64 (44 on mobile) and weights 400, 600, 700.
Use the spacing scale and 120px desktop section rhythm.
State the $30 price and Buy action once in the hero; keep the compact Buy $30 in the nav.
Keep text at 12px or larger and targets at 44px or larger.
Label every example number as an example.
forbidden: Hand-drawn redesign mockups that skip this pack (rejected 2026-11-04).
Claiming owner approval or production acceptance without durable evidence.
reviewChecklist: Shapeable audit:sitewide reports 100/100 with full route coverage on two identical passes.
The page meets the five-section and two-sentence limits on home.
The owner has reviewed the exact preview on localhost before any push.

runnableEvidence.expected: 100/100, 100% profile coverage, 7 of 7 eligible routes (recorded as site-audit-20261104175147). This is the pre-redesign baseline.
runnableEvidence.scope: Production waterfall.sh before the redesign; run from shapeable.art.

runnableEvidence.expected: 100/100, 100% profile coverage, 7 of 7 eligible routes on production after the redesign (commit 21465a3), following four identical 100/100 preview passes with zero findings.
runnableEvidence.scope: Production waterfall.sh after the Shapeable redesign; run from shapeable.art.
